mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.perm_code,p.perm_name FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_perm rp ON p.id = rp.perm_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN user u ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
